Before opening, a quick reminder for readers
It concerns the desk
Travelers using the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways need to follow pet check-in rules closely and share any comfort concerns early.
Safe Pet Travel Notice

Please bring your animal in a secure carrier or on the lead setup allowed for the trip, and keep documents ready for review. The welfare coordinator checks comfort needs, while the passenger coordinator helps explain the steps that must be followed. Keep messages clear and respectful, since quick updates help staff respond without delay.

If you are traveling with a pet that needs special care, tell the desk before arrival so the team can guide you on space, handling, and screening needs. <<FACT F002>> Watch for staff direction at all times, and do not remove your pet from control unless a team member tells you it is safe. <<FACT F028>> If your pet seems unwell, stressed, or unable to travel safely, let the desk know at once so the trip plan can be reviewed.

Use the Companion Animal Travel Desk for help before departure and again if plans change.
